about: Story table for tools/hack/check_progression.py (and check_hardlock.py): legs in v2 story order, Act 1 to the post-game (ids 1.xx-7.xx, P.xx). Each leg's scenes happen first (script labels: the object, coord trigger, sign or OnFrame entry that starts them; 'at' / 'map' / 'talk' when a label is used in several places or started by C, 'then' where a scene warps to one of several places, 'expect' flags/vars/items/TRAINER_X the scene must set, 'pre' + 'why' what C code does first), then the player walks to where the next leg's first scene starts (or to 'to': 'MAP_X x y', a MAP name, or a label; through the 'via' waypoints first). 'have' is the badges/HMs by then. 'assume': what a specialvar's C function returns; 'puzzles': gyms whose puzzle is C code; 'no_heal_ok': maps where being shut in without a heal location is the design. 'from': where a side trip starts if not where the last leg ended. Ids: the revenge arc 6.R1 - 6.R7, the rivals' route fights <leg>r, side trips <leg>b and 7x.xx; new scenes go in as their own legs where they happen (docs/hack_progression.md, Extending).

no_heal_ok.MAP_EVER_GRANDE_CITY_SIDNEYS_ROOM: the Elite Four (vanilla): each room's door shuts behind the player, a loss whites out and resets them
no_heal_ok.MAP_EVER_GRANDE_CITY_CHAMPIONS_ROOM: the Champion's room (vanilla): the Hall of Fame is the only way on
no_heal_ok.MAP_EVER_GRANDE_CITY_HALL_OF_FAME: the Hall of Fame scene sends the player home
no_heal_ok.MAP_SS_TIDAL_CORRIDOR: the SS Tidal: the crossing (C: the step counter, or the cabin bed) lands the player in Lilycove or Slateport

puzzles.MAP_SOOTOPOLIS_CITY_GYM_1F: the cracking ice floor and its stairs (C: ice step counter, OnFrame stair unlocks)
